title: Meh value.
text:
Low value in my opinion. Ziploc bags, flushable wipes, deodorant, shampoo, and conditioner weren't what I envisioned when I signed up. The sunglasses were nice but unfortunately useless to me as I wear prescription glasses.

Edit(7/7/21): I do have to say I rather like the deoderant. I tried the eye cream but I don't think I like it, made them feel really dry.
label: neutral
